declared difference (truth fix T2, minified code): the first setInterval/setTimeout(<name>, of a file was taken as its
poll loop even on a minified line (a bundled library such as three.js, inlined in a page or shipped as *.min.js), so
the library's internal setTimeout(n,0) was reported (lib.min.js) or masked the page's own poll loop (page.html). A
line longer than 1000 bytes is minified code and is not searched for the poll call now.
